what: FeatureMatch diagnosis step 3: baselines on the filtered pool (instances_v2f)

labels.in-process: reference, black-box, self_probe, template_probe and the zero-effort recipes: inproc_step3.py (inproc_gates path, one gpuq job)
labels.offline: SR variants: sr_recipe.py from the bank-R activation cache

inproc_run.label: in-process (inproc_gates.py path via diagnosis/step3/inproc_step3.py; NOT through the broker)
inproc_run.seeds: 1000*k+7 (k=0 for every solver; reference k=0..4, stop at first pass)

rule.text_per_style: first listed in the bank-R file
rule.auroc: reference_solver.auroc (ties 1/2), claimed option's texts vs the other options' texts

family_definition: anchor concept id prefix: 'topic:' -> topic, 'lang:' -> language; family pass = every slot of that family in the episode is correct (episodes with >= 1 such slot)

gate.rule: every non-reference recipe except SR: planted accuracy <= 0.15; reference (one-shot) planted accuracy >= 0.95; point estimates decide, 'robust' = the Wilson 95% CI is on the same side of the bar

stop_rule.rule: fires if primary SR-max or SR-thr planted accuracy (all tiers pooled) > 0.5 with n_planted >= 100; borderline if every firing variant's Wilson 95% CI includes 0.5
stop_rule.P6_note: The filtered pool failed the PREREG P6 fingerprint check narrowly (menu-feature CV AUROC 0.616 in the close tiers, bar 0.60; style_filter_out/v2f_summary.json). The fingerprint is a statistic of the menus that only a policy trained on menu statistics could exploit; the SR recipe never looks at menu statistics, so it cannot have raised SR's accuracy (A3.1).

criterion3_inputs.note: PREREG section 4 criterion 3 inputs, measured on the filtered pool
